newsitem.title: ITALY: CIR stake in Olivetti 6.29 pct.
newsitem.headline: CIR stake in Olivetti 6.29 pct.

text.p: Italian information technology group Olivetti said CIR, the industrial holding company of Carlo De Benedetti, had lowered its stake in Olivetti to 6.29 percent by April 4.
This is below a seven percent threshold beyond which by law anyone buying more shares must carry out a public offer to buy.
"The shares currently held by CIR Spa represent 6.29 percent of share capital with voting rights," Olivetti said in a newspaper tombstone published on Wednesday.
CIR said at the end of March its shareholding in Olivetti was eight percent and De Benedetti has said he intended to decrease CIR shareholding as far as five percent but no lower.
